args.says: Three full-body sessions a week, alternating A and B, each lift gated 3×5

ret: 2 training days (A and B) holding 4 exercises, over block weeks train, repeating.

Block weeks: train, repeating. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed. Loads on a 2.5 kg grid; distances on a 0.001 km grid (a target exactly between two grid steps rounds up).
Rotation: Alternate Day A / Day B, 3 sessions per training week.
Attendance (from the rotation): Train at least 3 times in each 7-day window (from your start day). If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.
squat: 3 sets of 5 reps on Barbell Back Squat; add 2.5 kg after every session where all sets hit; after 3 misses in a row, propose dropping to 90% of the weight.
bench: 3 sets of 5 reps on Barbell Bench Press; add 1.25 kg after every session where all sets hit; after 3 misses in a row, propose dropping to 90% of the weight.
press: 3 sets of 5 reps on Overhead Press; add 1.25 kg after every session where all sets hit; after 3 misses in a row, propose dropping to 90% of the weight.
dead: 1 set of 5 reps on Deadlift; add 5 kg after every session where all sets hit; after 3 misses in a row, propose dropping to 90% of the weight.
Hands on squatLoad: the squat slot's working weight when the program ends.
1 training day (A) holding 1 exercise, over block weeks train, repeating.
Block weeks: train, repeating. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed. Loads on a 2.5 kg grid.
Rotation: Each training week: Day A.
Attendance (from the rotation): Train at least 1 time in each 7-day window (from your start day). If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.
main: 5/3/1 on Barbell Back Squat off 100 kg, with up to three jokers when the top set makes its reps, then 3–5 sets of 5 at the first-set weight (with Joker step = 110%).
